description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Critical Damage +50%] to all allies, grants [Attach Earth], [Awoken Earth], [Damage Cap +10000] and [I'll Protect You Mode] to the user

description.name: Critical Damage +50%
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Earth
description.text: Earth abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: I'll Protect You Mode
description.text: Cast speed x2.00, keeps track of the number of Earth abilities used (0~4), grants [I'll Protect You Critical] after using a Earth ability
